**Live verification** (Go 1.26, module built to `helix-prompt`, realistic repo tree with flat prompts plus one legacy nested prompt):

```
=== list (before register) ===
[unregistered] bugfix/1 -> v1.md
[unregistered] feature/2 -> v2.md
[unregistered] refactor/1 -> v1.md

=== register feature 2 (flat) ===
registered feature/2 -> /tmp/demo/prompts/feature/v2.md

=== register refactor 3 (nested wins) ===
registered refactor/3 -> /tmp/demo/prompts/refactor/3/prompt.md

=== list (after register) ===
[unregistered] bugfix/1 -> v1.md
[registered] feature/2 -> v2.md
[unregistered] refactor/1 -> v1.md

=== register missing ===
error: prompt nosuch/1 not found (tried nested ".../nosuch/1/prompt.md", flat v1.md and 1.md)
exit=1
```

The legacy nested `refactor/3/prompt.md` resolved via the helper but correctly stays out of the flat `list` output, while its sibling flat `refactor/1 -> v1.md` is surfaced as unregistered.

**Test suite — 14/14 pass**, `go vet` clean, `gofmt -l` empty, `go test -race` clean. Edge cases covered:

| Edge case | Result |
|---|---|
| Nested only (`…/1/prompt.md`) | resolves nested |
| Flat only (`v1.md`) | resolves flat |
| Flat bare spelling (`3.md`) | resolves flat |
| Both layouts present | nested wins |
| Missing prompt | error listing all 3 tried paths |
| Empty category/version | rejected with clear error |
| `v1.md` exists as a *directory* | skipped, falls through to `1.md` |
| `README.md`, nested `prompt.md` in `list` | ignored |
| Sorting | numeric (`1, 2, 10`), not lexical |
| Registry round-trip / register-then-list | `[registered]` vs `[unregistered]` correct |
| Empty prompts dir | empty list, no error |
